CustomEasingEngineHint: Replaces DOTween with a lightweight easing engine for MoveTrack/RecolorTrack/MoveDecoration. Incompatible with individual optimize options above.
CustomEasingEngineConflictDetected: Custom Easing Engine was auto-disabled due to conflicting optimization settings. Please re-enable it after disabling MoveTrack/RecolorTrack/MoveDecoration optimizations.
AsyncInputHint: Improves audio timing accuracy and reduces input lag by using high-precision system timers. Recommended for high BPM / dense levels.
AsyncInputWarning: Warning: Levels played with this feature enabled must be clearly marked. The Iridium development team assumes no responsibility for any consequences arising from unmarked levels.
IgnoreRequiredModsWarning: Required third-party mods will be ignored. The level may not play correctly.
CustomEventReadOnlyNotice: These events only work when the third-party mod is installed. You can only disable or remove them.
EnableOptimizerInfo: Master switch for Iridium's optimizations. When disabled, every option below is ignored and the game runs with vanilla logic.
CompressImageInfo: Compresses custom level textures (backgrounds, decorations) on load to reduce VRAM usage. Disable if textures look degraded.
ShowSavedMemoryInfo: Shows how much VRAM texture compression saved when a level loads.
UseLossyCompressionInfo: Uses DXT (lossy) compression instead of lossless. Much lower VRAM usage with a slight quality loss; useful for low-VRAM GPUs.
LossyQualityInfo: Quality of lossy texture compression (10-100). Lower values save more memory but introduce more artifacts.
MultipleOf4Info: Resizes textures to multiples of 4 pixels so GPU block compression formats can be applied efficiently.
DivideImageByInfo: Downscales every custom texture by this factor before compression (2 = half width and height). Higher saves more VRAM but lowers sharpness.
DontResizeColliderInfo: Keeps decoration colliders at their original size even after textures are downscaled, so hitbox-based decorations keep working.
DisableShadowsInfo: Forces Unity shadows off while the optimizer is enabled. Real-time shadows are expensive; disabling them usually gains FPS.
OptimizeDecorationUpdateInfo: Caches decoration components and skips redundant per-frame lookups during decoration updates.
OptimizeTileUpdateInfo: Caches components per floor and skips redundant work in each tile's update path.
OptimizeMoveTrackInfo: Speeds up MoveTrack event handling by avoiding repeated component lookups while track motion tweens run.
OptimizeRecolorTrackInfo: Speeds up RecolorTrack event handling by caching components and skipping redundant color work.
SkipEventIfPausedInfo: Skips applying events to floors (ApplyEventsToFloors) while the game is paused.
OptimizeEventIconsInfo: Only refreshes floor event icon sprites when the icon actually changes.
OptimizeScnGameUpdateInfo: Trims scnGame.Update: caches components and skips redundant state checks and allocations each frame.
OptimizeMoveDecorationsInfo: Processes MoveDecorations events in batched passes instead of iterating decorations one by one.
OptimizeFfxDecorationsInfo: Skips update work for off-screen or fully static FFX decorations. Note: may cause visual desync on complex FFX levels.
OptimizeFloorMeshInfo: Reuses cached floor mesh data and only rebuilds meshes when the shape actually changes.
OptimizeFiltersInfo: Reduces the cost of filter events (screen effects) by avoiding redundant camera/filter reconfiguration.
FastLoadingInfo: Speeds up level loading by trimming initialization work such as event application and object setup.
EnableCustomEasingEngineInfo: Replaces DOTween with a lightweight built-in easing engine for MoveTrack / RecolorTrack / MoveDecorations. Mutually exclusive with those individual optimize toggles above.
OptimizeParticleInfo: Master switch for the particle optimizations below.
OptimizeParticleInactiveInfo: Skips simulation of inactive particle systems and pools them for reuse instead of Instantiate/Destroy.
OptimizeParticleCullingInfo: Pauses particle simulation while the emitter is outside the visible area.
OptimizeParticleLodInfo: Reduces particle counts (LOD) when many particle systems are emitting at once.
CacheGameObjectReferencesInfo: Caches GetComponent results across hot scene paths so they stop re-querying every frame.
OptimizeEventProcessingInfo: Pre-buckets level events at load time so runtime processing can quickly skip irrelevant events.
OptimizeEditorMouseDetectionInfo: Uses spatial partitioning for editor mouse picking instead of testing every floor and decoration.
OptimizeEditorEventIndicatorsInfo: Only redraws editor event indicator UI when the selection actually changes.
CacheFloorEventsInfo: Builds a floor-to-events dictionary once at load time instead of scanning the whole event list for every floor.
OptimizeMoveTrackTweensInfo: Creates MoveTrack tweens lazily and in batches so loading does not stall on thousands of tween allocations.
BatchMoveDecorationsInfo: Applies MoveDecorations through batched transform updates rather than per-decoration coroutine work.
CustomLevelReadOptimizationInfo: Faster JSON deserialization path for .adofai files: less boxing, fewer temporary allocations.
FrameSpreadDecorationLoadingInfo: Spawns level decorations over several frames instead of all at once, preventing long freezes when loading heavy levels.
DecorationsPerFrameInfo: How many decorations to instantiate per frame while frame-spread loading is active (10-500).
EnableDOTweenOptimizationInfo: Tunes DOTween globally: pre-sized pools and cheaper setup to reduce GC pressure from tweens.
TweenerCapacityInfo: Initial DOTween Tweener pool size (200-2000). Set this near your level's typical concurrent tween count.
DOTweenDefaultRecyclableInfo: Makes new tweens recyclable by default, so they return to the pool instead of being garbage collected.
DOTweenDisableSafeModeInfo: Disables DOTween safe-mode checks. Slightly faster, but destroyed targets throw errors instead of being silently ignored.
EnableExtremeOptimizationInfo: Spreads heavy operations such as tween creation across multiple frames. For extreme charts with tens of thousands of objects.
MaxTweensPerFrameInfo: Maximum tweens created per frame under Extreme Optimization (50-500). Lower = smoother frames but slower full load.
EnableMemoryOptimizationInfo: Master switch for the memory features below (scene-switch cleanup and FerriteCore).
FerriteCoreInfo: Enables the embedded FerriteCore module, which deduplicates identical textures and meshes shared between assets. Individual settings live in FerriteCore's own config file.
OptimizePlayerInputAllocationsInfo: Removes per-frame heap allocations in player input handling, preventing GC spikes from input polling.
OptimizeRDInputAllocationsInfo: Removes per-frame heap allocations caused by rebuilding the input key list.
RemoveNewsInfo: Hides the news panel on the main menu.
HideBetaWatermarkInfo: Hides the beta version watermark overlay.
ForceDifficultyUIInfo: Forces the full difficulty UI (ShowAll) in CLS levels where the game would normally hide it.
AlwaysCountdownInfo: Plays the countdown when starting play-testing in the editor, where the game normally skips it.
EnablePausePlanetTrailInfo: Keeps the pause planets' motion trail visible when the pause menu opens (the game normally disables it).
EnableCircleArcInfo: Rounded corner visuals: turns within the configured angle range get the large rounded corner (default 90-105, matching vanilla right angles). Adjust the range to give obtuse turns the same arc instead of a sharp corner. Near-straight turns keep their vanilla look.
ShowAutoplayHintUIInfo: Shows an on-screen hint overlay during autoplay.
CustomAutoplayHintInfo: Lets you customize the autoplay hint text with a template instead of using the built-in text.
MoveAutoplayTextInfo: Unlocks the position of the autoplay status text so you can move it anywhere with the X/Y sliders below.
EnableJudgeTextCustomizationInfo: Lets you customize judgement texts (Perfect, TooEarly...) including showing exact timing via {offset}.
EnableLegacyPauseFixInfo: Restores the v2.9.3 pause behavior for compatibility with older charts and mods.
EnableNoFailTooEarlyInfo: Under No Fail, lethal decoration collisions are converted to 'TooEarly' judgments instead of killing you.
ScaleFilterSpeedWithPitchInfo: Scales filter effect animation speed with pitch/playback rate so visuals stay in sync at different speeds.
FixCameraRelativeDragInfo: Fixes decoration dragging offset when the camera is rotated or zoomed in the editor.
PortalTravelFixInfo: Ignores portal triggers while a level transition is already running, preventing state corruption.
FixEditorPlayResetMistakesInfo: Resets the mistake counter correctly when starting play-testing from the editor.
FixTurnaroundConditionInfo: Aligns turnaround (hairpin) detection with v2.9.8 behavior, fixing misjudged turnarounds in edge cases.
FixJudgeRotationInfo: Fixes judge text not rotating in single player mode.
FixCoopPauseLockInfo: Applies the pause beat lock per player in co-op mode instead of globally.
ForceAngleDataInfo: Forces reading angle data as-is for legacy charts instead of auto-correcting it.
UseILPatchInfo: IL Transpiler mode: direct IL injection, best performance. Turn off for Prefix/Postfix mode: standard Harmony patches, best compatibility.
IgnoreRequiredModsInfo: Skips the required-mods check so you can join lobbies without installing every listed mod. May cause missing features or crashes.
EnableHitSoundPitchInfo: Hit sounds follow the music pitch/speed setting instead of playing at fixed pitch.
EnableAsyncInputInfo: Improves audio timing accuracy and reduces input latency using high-precision system timers. Recommended for high BPM / dense charts.
EnableLobbyMusicPatchInfo: Enables lobby music customization below. Some changes may require re-entering the lobby to fully apply.
EnableCustomBpmInfo: Overrides the BPM used for lobby music sync.
LobbyFastMusicInfo: Uses a separate faster music track in the lobby when game speed is above 1x.
LobbyCustomMusicInfo: Replaces lobby music with your own audio files configured below.
EnableEditorShortcutsInfo: Adds editor keyboard shortcuts for decoration selection and navigation (listed below).
CameraFollowOnFloorSelectInfo: Moves the editor camera to the selected floor when using Go To Floor / Select All Floors.
EditorPauseAllowedInfo: Allows pausing/resuming while auto-playing inside the editor.
EditorPauseEnabledInfo: Enables the custom pause key binding below during editor autoplay.
EnableEditorFloorOptimizationInfo: Master switch for editor floor performance optimizations below. Recommended when editing very long charts.
IncrementalFloorInsertInfo: Inserting/deleting floors only touches nearby floors instead of rebuilding the whole level.
RangeBasedRedrawInfo: After edits, only redraws holds/planets/numbers within the affected range instead of everything.
SkipRedundantRemakePathInfo: Skips RemakePath calls when nothing visually changed.
OptimizeOffsetFloorEventsInfo: Rewrites OffsetFloorIDsInEvents to avoid repeated full-list scans.
